suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as association risk. Require schizophrenia before/with subsequent T2DM and separately establish diabetes; evaluate antipsychotic exposure, obesity, diet, activity, family history, and metabolic disease. Meta-analysis supports elevated risk but heterogeneity and treatment/metabolic confounding are substantial. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
